prompt:
Paint one game inventory icon in Heavenprint: hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken, directional brush
strokes, selective dry-brush scumbling and restrained hatching where a contour or crease needs it, charcoal shadows,
warm ivory accents on the focal edges, quiet low-detail areas. Not line art, not flat ink, not a photograph, not a 3D
render, no airbrushed gloss and no uniform digital sharpness. One single object, three-quarter view, lit from one
side (upper left), with a short soft painted shading on its own underside only: no ground, no cast shadow, no scene.
Fully transparent background. Square canvas, 1024 x 1024 PNG with alpha; the object fills about 80% of the canvas
(keep it inside the central 80 to 85%, about 100 px of clear margin on every side). No text, no letters, no numbers,
no logos, no maker marks, no borders, no frame, no hands and no figures. Everything is invented: never a recognisable
real-world make, model or emblem. The silhouette must be bold and instantly readable first: the icon is shown at 64 px
in a shop grid and at 32 px in a backpack row, so keep detail concentrated on one or two focal edges and make the
shape unmistakable when shrunk. Colour: metal is painted in the palette's neutrals (charcoal, steel grey, warm ivory
highlights); the faction's signature colour is the single accent (given in each prompt). Rarity is not shown by a
coloured border (the UI adds that): standard finish only, with honest wear. Scale within a family stays consistent:
every object in one family fills the frame by the same rule, given in its family paragraph.

FAMILY: **Focuses: the four gloves** (focus). Evoker, Emanator, Visualizer and Attuner are one family (the standard gloves of the gear companies' line): a single glove, no hand inside, empty but with the shape of a hand, worn on the hand and read at 32 px as a hand. Each has a different heart: the Evoker is angular with a hexagonal core window on the back of the hand and a stylus-point index finger (Intelligence cyan #8BDEEE); the Emanator is rounded on a long bracer with a round emitter lens in the palm and a heart-link line to the cuff (Determination violet #9D7ADC); the Visualizer is palm toward the viewer with a projector lens set in the middle of the palm (Expression #5394AC); the Attuner is back of the hand toward the viewer with a small round core on the back of the hand and fine filaments running from it to each fingertip, one filament lit (Insight rose #EB95B7). The same leather, stitching and wear level on all four, the same scale (the glove fills about 85% of the canvas height). Only the glow differs, and only inside the lens or window.
SUBJECT: Attuner . VISUAL DESIGN:  a small round core set on the back of the hand, and from it a fan of very fine filaments laid along the back of the hand and each finger to its fingertip (five thin lines, one to each tip, like the veins of a leaf), with one of the five filaments lit; fingers slightly curled as if just closed on a thread. The cuff is plain. **Materials and accent:** the same pale ceramic and dark grey leather as the Visualizer, thin brass-grey wire for the filaments; accent: Insight rose #EB95B7, only in the small core and in the one lit filament, contained, no bloom. **At 32 px:** Against the Evoker (angular, one hexagonal window) and the Visualizer (palm out, big lens): the Attuner is back-of-hand with a round dot and a fan of thin lines to the fingertips, one of them rose.
Match reference painted materials only. No scene, no person. Clean transparency.
